name: Elon
overview: Elon was a male judge of Israel from the tribe of Zebulun. He is recognized as a descendant of Zebulun who served as one of the judges, providing leadership during a period of Israel's history characterized by decentralized governance. His role as a judge signifies his importance in maintaining order and justice among the Israelites.
namesAndTitles: The name Elon is a proper name meaning "species of a mighty tree." This meaning suggests strength and stability, qualities befitting a judge of Israel. The name was not given directly by God but is recorded in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Elon is explicitly identified as a descendant of Zebulun, linking him to one of the twelve tribes of Israel. Beyond this tribal affiliation, Scripture does not record any additional family relationships for Elon.
scriptureSignificance: Elon's significance lies in his role as a judge of Israel, a position that involved leadership and adjudication during a formative period in Israel's history. His connection to the tribe of Zebulun situates him within the tribal structure that shaped Israelite society. Though the biblical record of Elon is brief, his inclusion among the judges underscores his contribution to the governance and spiritual oversight of the nation.
